text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The New Year is here. ☆ And today's the
start of
my senior year! Right, Trainer? ♪
So!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's time to try out a different kind of
feng shui to
commemorate the occasion!
That's exciting,
right? Right?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Then off we go! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey is always energetic, but
this new
year, she's got even more
energy to spare than
usual.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
First up is a good luck charm! Buying
one before
you pray is the Rickey
way. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That way, when you pray, you feel like
your good
luck charm gets powered up
too. Makes sense,
right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next up is learning the right way to pray!
Let's
make our wishes into a thank-you
sandwich!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Say thank you, make your wish, then say
thank you again. It's important you never
forget to show
the gods your
appreciation. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that doesn't just go for gods,
but
everyone. So thank you, Trainer! For
everything
you do for me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Last is the fortune slips! You don't tie
them to anything, though—you take
them home with you. ☆ Otherwise, you
might forget what they
said.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you hang it up in a place where it'll
catch your
eye from time to time, it'll
help you keep things in
perspective. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You know... her methods sound quite
practical
and effective.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After enjoying our trip to the shrine...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You think? I don't feel any different.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae?! Of course not! Nope. Not at
all...
choice_data_list: Are you still worried about Hokko ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fact she's denying it so strongly has
to mean
it's still on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae told her to focus on
running, and
not to go off on any feng
shui-related detours.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer. The life line on my
palm is
saying that this year's qi flow is
in for a drastic
change.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So how about we try grabbing onto that
new
flow? We can go someplace where
we can check
out the latest trends.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, there are all kinds of
trends. Trends
in entertainment,
economic trends...
choice_data_list: Sure, but where is this place?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We can go with whichever you'd like.
What kind
do you want to learn about?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first thing that pops into my head
is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fun fashion! I think I know where to go
for that!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, it's gotta be the shopping mall. ☆
There are a lot of brand-name shops
here, so it'll be easy to
see what colors
are popular too.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Look at all the different hues! Just
seeing it all is
putting me in a good
mood!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, that outfit looks pretty nice. ♪
It's got
all my lucky colors for this year!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That said, I can't say I'm too happy
about the
price. Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I accompany Copano Rickey on a tour of
the
shopping mall. It seems to put the
pep back in her
step.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The rich and powerful... So it'd have to
be
somewhere big shots hang out. I think
I know a
place!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's a first-rate hotel! We can get a feel
for what's
trending among rich people
by just looking
around the lobby.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So the shape of that flower vase
brings
good luck, huh? And the color of
the flowers
seems important, too...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think I've just freshened up my
feng shui
for this year! I feel like I've
really improved. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Copano Rickey's brush with
high society
has broadened her horizons.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What's going on locally, huh? In that
case, I know
a place with a great view of
the town.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. It looks really windy outside
today. It's like
I can literally see the qi
flowing!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The westerly winds from the continent
seem
strong today. Oh. If you look
closely...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The buildings all have differently shaped
roofs. Some are pointed ones and some
are flat. I
wonder if that has any
influence on luck.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, let's go see if we can find out.
Looking at the architecture and stuff
might help us learn how
to improve our
luck too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After looking down from a high vantage
point, Copano Rickey makes an
unexpected discovery.
She seems to
have gained a new perspective.
